additional_branch.first_failed_hypothesis: the outgoing condition is ILL-DEFINED for the additional sector; the additional-branch BVP is NOT well-posed with the standard radiation condition
additional_branch.obstruction: the standard outgoing radiation condition does NOT separate the log tail: e^{i omega r_*} r^s and e^{i omega r_*} r^s log r are BOTH outgoing, so no unique outgoing amplitude is fixed
additional_branch.resolution_required: a modified (log-renormalized) outgoing condition -- a declared MISSING object
additional_branch.shared_oscillation_rate: exp(-2 I omega r) (oscillatory branch); the composed metric adds a log r at the same exponent
additional_branch.type: log-tailed (BH2C_FLUX_CLASS: pure-power ansatz INCONSISTENT, single-log ansatz CONSISTENT with nonzero log part)

bvp_definition.exterior_domain: r in (2m, infinity); tortoise r_* in (-infinity, +infinity)
bvp_definition.horizon_condition: ingoing / regular: the certified indicial exponent, F ~ e^{-2 i m omega r_*} (roots ['-2*I*m*omega', '2*I*m*omega'])
bvp_definition.operator: the parity-unified master ODE c2 F'' + c1 F' + c0 F = 0 (BH2C_METRIC_ALL_ORDERS) for the Einstein branch; the fourth-order Bach system for the additional branch
bvp_definition.outer_condition: outgoing / radiation: F ~ e^{+ i omega r_*} at infinity (standard, log-free form)

declaration.gate: existence/uniqueness of the exterior complex-omega BVP for each branch, or the first well-posedness obstruction
declaration.setting: Schwarzschild exterior, axial l = 2, complex omega; polar via the parity-unified master ODE (fixture-level)
declaration.theory: pure-Weyl gravity L = alpha C_abcd C^abcd

einstein_branch.W_analytic: W_E(omega) is analytic in omega on the declared domain (BH3_ANALYTIC_CONTINUATION_GATE: both boundary solutions continue analytically)
einstein_branch.W_not_identically_zero: the two boundary solutions are generically linearly independent, so W_E is not identically zero; its zero set is therefore DISCRETE
einstein_branch.disposition: EXISTENCE and UNIQUENESS hold on the declared complex-omega domain MINUS the discrete zero set of W_E; on that set the homogeneous BVP acquires a nontrivial kernel (uniqueness fails)
einstein_branch.exceptional_set: the discrete zeros of W_E(omega) -- exactly the transcendental (confluent-Heun) connection object left OPEN by the endpoint assembly; NOT computed here (that is the forbidden quasinormal problem)
einstein_branch.type: log-free (BH2C_ASYMPTOTIC_JORDAN: homogeneous formal systems are log-free)
einstein_branch.wellposedness_criterion: the two-ended BVP is Fredholm; a nontrivial solution exists iff the horizon-ingoing and infinity-outgoing solutions are linearly dependent, i.e. iff the connection Wronskian W_E(omega) = 0

einstein_vs_additional: the Einstein-branch BVP is log-free and standard (well-posed modulo the discrete W_E zeros); the additional-branch BVP is log-tailed and OBSTRUCTED at the outgoing condition -- the two BVPs are structurally distinct

headline.statement: the exterior complex-omega BVP is well-posed (existence + uniqueness) for the log-free Einstein branch away from a discrete exceptional set (the connection-Wronskian zeros), and is OBSTRUCTED for the log-tailed additional branch, whose standard outgoing radiation condition is ill-defined

a modified (log-renormalized) outgoing condition that resolves the additional-branch log tail
